An editable reconstruction of the supplied **fomo limit close orders** reference:
**1108 frames at 60 fps**, rendered at **1920×1080**. Six scenes recreate the
original story, interface, light-to-dark transitions, and camera movements.
The picture is React and SVG; it does not play or require the reference MP4.

## Usage

```tsx
import { Composition } from "remotion";
import {
  FomoLimitOrders,
  FOMO_FRAMES,
  FOMO_FPS,
  FOMO_WIDTH,
  FOMO_HEIGHT,
} from "@/components/remocn/templates/fomo-limit-orders";

export const RemotionRoot = () => (
  <Composition
    id="FomoLimitOrders"
    component={FomoLimitOrders}
    durationInFrames={FOMO_FRAMES}
    fps={FOMO_FPS}
    width={FOMO_WIDTH}
    height={FOMO_HEIGHT}
    defaultProps={{}}
  />
);
```

## Customize

```tsx
<FomoLimitOrders
  brandName="Forma"
  accentColor="#7973ff"
  content={{
    intro: "introducing",
    ticker: "ACME",
    assetName: "Acme (Tokenized)",
    limitPrice: "$210.00",
    action: "Place limit close",
    closing: "trade by your own rules",
  }}
  audioSrc={staticFile("your-soundtrack.m4a")}
  volume={0.8}
/>
```

Import `staticFile` from `remotion` when using local media in your public folder.
Audio is optional. The install is silent by default and includes no third-party
soundtrack. Use audio you have permission to use.

`content.ts` contains the copy and trading values. `motion.ts` contains timing,
easing, and the measured slider contraction curve. The six files in `scenes/`
contain the individual shots. `ui.tsx` contains reusable interface details.
The 480×270 design coordinate system scales uniformly into the composition.
Keep short labels close to the original lengths, or adjust their scene layout.

| Scene | Time | Motion |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Opening | 0–2.70s | Word entrances and floating glass |
| Phone | 2.70–8.00s | Asset reveal, camera travel, point-to-screen wipe |
| Slider | 8.00–10.90s | Label roll, zoom, counters, slider-to-caret morph |
| Price | 10.90–12.60s | Interface reveal, typing, camera push, stationary fade |
| Confirmation | 12.60–14.15s | Order filling and camera approach |
| Closing | 14.15–18.47s | Word-by-word line and brand reveal |

## Render in this repository

```bash
bun run studio:fomo
bun run render:fomo
bun run review:fomo
```

The render writes `out/fomo-limit-orders.mp4`. To recreate the soundtrack from
your own local reference alongside the new picture:

```bash
bun run render:fomo --reference-audio=/absolute/path/to/reference.mp4
```

This removes the corresponding 12.60–14.45s section from the reference audio,
extracts it with FFmpeg into a temporary directory, supplies it to the
composition, and removes the temporary files after rendering. It never adds the
reference video or audio to the public registry.

The original font assets were unavailable. Typography uses bundled Manrope.
The perspective control scene has been removed; the price shot fades directly
into the order confirmation. The ball follows the phone border in its local
coordinate system, including the rounded corner and camera movement.
